candidates.caveat: Genesis structures creation over six days and divine rest on the seventh; Quran refers to six days, enthronement and governing affairs without divine rest. Hebrew original and editions require checking; not evidence of dependence.
Daniel speaks of awakening to everlasting life or shame; Quran emphasizes return to God, recreation, reward and scalding punishment. Textual and manuscript witnesses require verification.
